# Aguea

> > Aguea is a social media archive and search platform preserving user profiles, hashtag searches, and content primarily from Arabic-speaking regions and Japanese communities.

The platform archives Twitter/X content with a strong focus on Middle Eastern discourse (Saudi Arabia, Lebanon, Egypt, Iraq, Palestine), Islamic content, and Japanese anime culture. It provides searchable hashtag collections and user profile snapshots across multiple languages.

## Key Topics

- Arabic social media content
- Middle East politics and news
- Islamic and Ramadan content
- Saudi Arabia (الرياض, السعودية)
- Regional entities (مصر, لبنان, العراق, فلسطين)
- Japanese anime communities
- Twitter/X archive preservation
- Hashtag search and aggregation
- User profile snapshots
- Sports commentary (الهلال, football)
- Religious content (القدس, الصباح)
- Gulf states (البحرين, الكويت)
- Cultural hashtags
- Multilingual content (Arabic, Japanese, English)
